title: ISMIP7 Antarctic Ocean Melt Calibration
description: Data for calibrating sub-ice-shelf melt parameterisations for ISMIP7 Antarctic experiments: ocean model output, hydrographic observations, observational estimates of melt rates, buttressing flux response numbers, drainage basins and ice-shelf masks, and the meltMIP intercomparison inputs. Third-party model output and observations from several groups, each with its own citation and licence — see the per-dataset attribution in the product README.
